heroSubheading: Full-service domestic relocations delivered by experienced, DBS-checked removal specialists. Fully insured.
summary: Moving house across Birmingham and the West Midlands is smooth with our professional moving company. Our directly employed, DBS-checked movers operate modern 3.5-tonne Luton removal vans equipped with electric tail-lifts, quilted transit blankets, and heavy-duty webbing straps. From terraced cottages to large detached homes, every house move includes room-by-room furniture placement, fully insured protection, and transparent fixed removal quotes with zero hidden completion delay fees.
benefits: Dedicated 3.5-tonne Luton fleet with hydraulic tail lifts
DBS-vetted, uniformed and experienced removals crews
Floor protection, mattress bags, and quilted transit blankets included
Operating 24 hours, 7 days a week with flexible booking windows

process.title: Transparent Survey & Quotation
process.description: We evaluate your property size, access considerations, and volume of items via video survey or online inventory to provide an itemised, guaranteed fixed price.

process.title: Preparation & Packing Support
process.description: If selected, our team arrives prior to moving day or early on the morning to pack glassware, wrap furnishings, and dismantle designated beds and wardrobes.

process.title: Protective Loading & Transit
process.description: Possessions are secured in our carpeted Luton vans using heavy-duty webbing straps and protective furniture blankets before direct transit to your new address.

process.title: Room-by-Room Placement & Sign-Off
process.description: We unload every item directly into the designated rooms at your new home and ensure you are completely satisfied before completing sign-off.

whatsIncluded: Full Luton removal van equipped with tail lift
2 to 4 uniformed removal specialists depending on property size
Transit blankets, sofa covers, mattress bags, and webbing ties
Floor runners for carpets and hardwood entrances
Direct delivery with no consolidation or intermediate depot transfers
whatsNotIncluded: Council parking suspension fees where bay permits are necessary
Disconnection and reconnection of gas appliances or hardwired electrics
Attic clearances where safe fixed flooring and lighting are not present
Hazardous substances, car batteries, fuels, and flammable paint liquids
priceNotes: Achievable price based on a typical 1-2 bedroom home move within a 10-mile radius in the West Midlands with standard vehicular access.

faqs.question: How do you calculate house removal costs?
faqs.answer: Our house removal quotations are calculated based on the cubic volume of your belongings, travel distance between properties, property access (flights of stairs, parking distance), and any optional services like packing or furniture dismantling.

faqs.question: What happens if there is a delay in receiving keys on completion day?
faqs.answer: We know property transactions can encounter delays at the bank or solicitor level. Our operations team remains in touch with you throughout the day and our quotation clearly details any waiting time parameters so you have zero surprise fees.

faqs.question: Do I need to empty chest of drawers and wardrobes before moving?
faqs.answer: For safety and structural integrity of furniture, wardrobes must be empty. Lightweight clothing may remain in sturdy chests of drawers provided they are not overloaded, but heavy items, books, and breakables must be packed into separate boxes.

faqs.question: Can your vans access narrow residential streets and terraced avenues?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our fleet predominantly uses 3.5-tonne Luton low-loader vans which provide the volume required for house moves while retaining the agility to navigate tight Victorian terraces across Birmingham and the Black Country.
